monograph.title: The Resonance Vaults: The Architecture of Acoustic Stratigraphy
monograph.core_thesis: Acoustic resonance within closed non-Euclidean chambers functions as load-bearing architectural substrate.
axioms: Wave nodes crystallize zero-point energy into spatial mass.
Harmonic eigenmodes prevent topological de-coherence across vault boundaries.
Historical soundscapes are permanent geological strata within the Ash Archive.
